description:
SCNodeClass is the node definition SCarpenter launches nodes from: shared
settings plus a block per vendor.

metadata.description: Standard object metadata; only the name is required.

spec.description:
SCNodeClassSpec is the node definition shared by every vendor, plus a typed
block per vendor (ADR-014). Which vendor a NodeClaim uses is chosen by the
NodePool's scarpenter.sparecores.com/vendor requirement.

billing.description:
billing opts in to keeping nodes until the end of the billing period
they have already paid for (ADR-024). Changing it is not drift.

margin.description:
margin is how long before the end of the period the node is released:
it has to cover the drain, the termination finalizer, the vendor's
delete and clock skew. At least 90 s; a vendor with a slow delete
widens it.

maxRetainedNodes.description:
maxRetainedNodes is an optional safety valve: it trims the held empty
nodes of the NodeClass down to this number, nearest deadline first.
Unset means no cap; a launch blocked by a NodePool limit or a vendor
quota releases held empty nodes first either way.

minPeriod.description:
minPeriod is the shortest billing increment that is held to its end:
shorter increments are not worth a hold. It does not gate the hold of a
minimum (a minimum has its own 2 minute floor).

retainUntilPeriodEnd.description:
retainUntilPeriodEnd keeps a node a vendor bills by the started period
(an hour on hcloud, UpCloud, Vultr), or by a minimum and then per second
(Alibaba), until its paid period is about to end, so that Karpenter
reuses it for the next job, and deletes it before the next charge starts.
Off by default.

bootstrap.description:
bootstrap holds the opt-in changes to the node's boot configuration that
a vendor's driver can contribute (plan 14 A7).

hardening.description:
hardening lists the opt-in hardenings of the boot configuration. Off by
default: they change what Pods on the node can reach. A vendor whose driver
offers none of them (AWS) ignores the list and says so in an Event.

items.description:
Hardening is a named, opt-in hardening of the node's boot configuration. A
driver that offers it contributes a Butane fragment that the core merges into
the base config.

butane.description:
butane references extra Butane configuration merged into every node's
Ignition.

configMapRef.description: configMapRef references the ConfigMap key holding the Butane config.

catalog.description: catalog configures the instance type catalog built from Keeper.

cpuFlagLabels.description:
cpuFlagLabels are the CPU flags that get a cpu-flag-<flag> label on
instance types. The set is closed: the labels are registered with
Karpenter core at start-up, so only this curated list of flags useful
for workload selection (names as in Keeper's cpu_flags, Linux
/proc/cpuinfo spelling) is accepted. Defaults to avx2, avx512f,
amx_tile and sha_ni.

flatcar.description: flatcar selects the Flatcar Container Linux release nodes boot.

version.description: version is the pinned release, e.g. 4757.2.3. Changing it drifts nodes.

kubelet.description:
kubelet configures the kubelet and the node capacity the scheduler
assumes.

kubeReserved.description:
kubeReserved overrides the computed resources reserved for Kubernetes
daemons.

maxPods.description: maxPods is the maximum number of Pods per node.

vmMemoryOverheadPercent.description:
vmMemoryOverheadPercent is the share of the catalog memory a VM does
not offer to the guest, subtracted from the instance type's capacity.

kubernetes.description:
kubernetes selects the Kubernetes release (a sysext-bakery release)
nodes run.

version.description: version of a sysext-bakery Kubernetes release, e.g. v1.37.1.

additionalProperties.description:
Metric defines a benchmark metric: a benchmark or a workload profile,
optionally normalised per vCPU. Exactly one of benchmark and workloadProfile
is set.

benchmark.description: benchmark identifies a Spare Cores benchmark (id and config).

config.description:
config is a JSON object. Required when the benchmark has more than one
config; validated against Keeper's benchmark_configs by comparing
parsed objects.

id.description: id is a benchmark_id, for example geekbench:score.

normalize.description: normalize is applied to the score before the labels are computed.

scale.description:
scale multiplies the score before it is rounded to the integer label
value, to keep precision (e.g. 100).

workloadProfile.description: workloadProfile is one of the Spare Cores compound workload benchmarks.

metrics.description:
metrics define benchmark metric labels (metric-<name>, -pct and -per-usd)
on instance types and offerings.

network.description:
network is the node bootstrap network template (how nodes reach the
control plane).

configMapRef.description: configMapRef references the ConfigMap key holding the Butane template.

authKeySecretRef.description:
authKeySecretRef references the Secret key holding the auth key nodes
join the tailnet with.

loginServer.description:
loginServer is the coordination server URL; empty means Tailscale SaaS,
set it for Headscale.

tags.description: tags are the ACL tags nodes advertise.

version.description: version of the Tailscale sysext, e.g. v1.98.10.

template.description:
template: tailscale joins nodes through a tailnet, direct has nodes
reach the API server directly, custom renders your own Butane template.

networking.description:
networking is the generic network setting, identical in meaning on every
vendor; vendor blocks may override it.

inbound.description:
inbound lists the allowed inbound traffic. Without rules everything
inbound is denied (a deny firewall is attached where the vendor default
is open).

rules.description: rules allow traffic from CIDRs; everything else is denied.

items.description: InboundRule allows inbound traffic from CIDRs.

cidrs.description: cidrs are the allowed source networks.

fromPort.description:
fromPort is the first port of the range (tcp and udp); without ports
the rule covers every port.

toPort.description: toPort is the last port of the range; defaults to fromPort.

isolation.description:
isolation decides who may reach a node privately: none (no other node:
the strictest, only inbound rules apply; it does not mean "not isolated"),
the nodes of the SCNodeClass, or only the nodes of the same run (placement
group run key; without a run key the nodes of the SCNodeClass are one run).

publicIPv4.description: publicIPv4 gives nodes a public IPv4 address.

publicIPv6.description: publicIPv6 gives nodes a public IPv6 address.

poweroffAfter.description:
poweroffAfter powers a node off after this long: a fail-safe against
instances that outlive their NodeClaim.

pricing.description: pricing configures how offerings are priced.

allowIncomplete.description:
allowIncomplete allows offerings whose price misses components the data
does not have (provisioned IOPS, dedicated tenancy, paid bandwidth).
Such nodes are annotated scarpenter.sparecores.com/price-incomplete.

profiles.description:
profiles are named, explicit, vendor-native setups that workloads pick
by name through labels.

additionalProperties.description: NetworkProfile is a named network setup (NIC features) per vendor.

alicloud.description: Network is the Alibaba Cloud block of a network profile.

internetChargeType.description: internetChargeType is how the public bandwidth is billed.

internetMaxBandwidthOut.description:
internetMaxBandwidthOut is the peak public outbound bandwidth in Mbit/s;
0 means no public IPv4 address.

aws.description: Network is the AWS block of a network profile.

enaExpress.description: enaExpress configures ENA Express on supported instance types.

udp.description: udp enables ENA Express for UDP traffic as well.

azure.description: Network is the Azure block of a network profile.

acceleratedNetworking.description:
acceleratedNetworking configures SR-IOV on the NIC. auto (the built-in
default) turns it on for sizes that support it and off elsewhere; true makes
the other sizes infeasible.

enabled.description: enabled is auto, "true" or "false" (quote the booleans).

fake.description: Network is the fake block of a network profile.

accelerated.description: accelerated marks the fake nodes as having accelerated networking.

gcp.description: Network is the GCP block of a network profile.

nicType.description: nicType selects the virtual NIC; unset leaves the series' default.

tier1.description:
tier1 turns on Tier 1 networking (higher egress bandwidth) on the series
that support it.

qemu.description: Network is the qemu block of a network profile.

model.description: model of the emulated network card.

vultr.description:
Network is the Vultr block of a network profile. Empty in v1: Vultr's create
call has no NIC features.

network.description: network profiles: NIC features.

additionalProperties.description: PlacementProfile is a named placement and tenancy setup per vendor.

alicloud.description: Placement is the Alibaba Cloud block of a placement profile.

deploymentSet.description:
deploymentSet is the placement construct nodes join; it needs a run key
(label placement-group) to be created per run.

strategy.description: strategy of the deployment sets SCarpenter creates.

use.description:
use references an existing deployment set, which is never modified or
deleted; the run key then only separates NodeClaims.

name.description: name of the deployment set.

aws.description:
Placement is the AWS block of a placement profile: a placement group and the
tenancy.

placementGroup.description:
placementGroup is the placement construct nodes join; it needs a run key
(label placement-group) to be created per run.

partitionCount.description: partitionCount is the number of partitions (strategy partition).

strategy.description: strategy of the placement groups SCarpenter creates.

use.description:
use references an existing placement group, which is never modified or
deleted; the run key then only separates NodeClaims.

name.description: name of the placement group.

tenancy.description:
tenancy of the instances: dedicated runs them on single-tenant
hardware.

azure.description: Placement is the Azure block of a placement profile.

proximityPlacementGroup.description:
proximityPlacementGroup is the placement construct nodes join; a profile
that creates groups needs a run key (label placement-group) to create one
per run.

strategy.description: strategy of the groups SCarpenter creates: cluster keeps the VMs close.

use.description:
use references an existing proximity placement group, which is never
modified or deleted; the run key then only separates NodeClaims.

name.description: name of the proximity placement group.

fake.description: Placement is the fake block of a placement profile.

group.description: group is the fake placement construct nodes join; it needs a run key.

gcp.description: Placement is the GCP block of a placement profile: a resource policy.

resourcePolicy.description:
resourcePolicy is the placement policy nodes join. A policy SCarpenter
creates needs a run key (label placement-group): one policy per run.

groupPlacement.description: groupPlacement places the instances close together (compact placement).

spread.description: spread spreads the instances over availability domains.

availabilityDomainCount.description: availabilityDomainCount is the number of availability domains.

use.description: use references an existing policy, which is never modified or deleted.

name.description: name of the resource policy.

hcloud.description: Placement is the Hetzner block of a placement profile: a placement group.

placementGroup.description:
placementGroup is the placement construct nodes join; a group SCarpenter
creates needs a run key (label placement-group). A spread group holds
at most 10 servers.

type.description: type of the placement groups SCarpenter creates.

use.description:
use references an existing placement group, which is never modified or
deleted; the run key then only separates NodeClaims.

name.description: name of the placement group.

ovh.description: Placement is the OVH block of a placement profile.

serverGroup.description:
serverGroup is the Nova server group nodes join; one is created per run
key (label placement-group).

policy.description: policy of the server groups SCarpenter creates.

use.description:
use references an existing server group, which is never modified or
deleted.

name.description: name of the server group.

qemu.description: Placement is the qemu block of a placement profile.

pinCPUs.description: pinCPUs pins the VM's vCPUs to host cores.

upcloud.description:
Placement is the UpCloud block of a placement profile: a server group.
UpCloud has no cluster or co-location construct and no dedicated tenancy, so
profiles that ask for them have no UpCloud block.

serverGroup.description:
serverGroup is the anti-affinity group nodes join; it needs a run key
(label placement-group) to be created per run.

antiAffinity.description: antiAffinity policy of the groups SCarpenter creates. Default strict.

use.description:
use references an existing server group by title, which is never modified
or deleted; the run key then only separates NodeClaims.

name.description: name is the title of the server group.

vultr.description:
Placement is the Vultr block of a placement profile. Empty in v1: Vultr has
no placement groups or tenancy choice.

placement.description: placement profiles: placement constructs and tenancy.

additionalProperties.description:
StorageProfile is a named storage setup, in the vendor's own terms, for each
vendor it applies to. On a vendor without a block the profile does not exist.

alicloud.description:
Storage is the Alibaba Cloud storage block: the system disk and the extra data
disks created with the instance. It is the vendor block's storage (layer 2)
and the alicloud block of a storage profile (layer 3).

data.description: data lists extra disks created with the instance (all deleted with it).

items.description:
DataDisk is an extra disk: ECS settings plus the guest side (name,
filesystem, mount path).

burstingEnabled.description: burstingEnabled turns performance bursting on for a cloud_auto disk.

category.description: category is the disk category. Built-in default cloud_essd.

encrypted.description: encrypted encrypts the disk. Built-in default false.

filesystem.description: filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume.

kmsKeyID.description: kmsKeyID is the KMS key used for encryption.

mountPath.description: mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at.

name.description:
name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints
rendered into Ignition.

performanceLevel.description: performanceLevel of a cloud_essd disk. Built-in default PL0.

localStorage.description:
localStorage is accepted so that a profile written for a vendor with
local disks is not pruned silently, but local disks are not supported on
Alibaba Cloud yet (the i and d families are deferred): only the policy
ignore is accepted, any other is refused when the object is applied.

mountPath.description: mountPath is the absolute path the local storage is mounted at.

policy.description:
policy: ignore leaves the disks alone, mount mounts them, raid0 stripes
them into one volume and mounts it.

burstingEnabled.description: burstingEnabled turns performance bursting on for a cloud_auto disk.

category.description: category is the disk category. Built-in default cloud_essd.

encrypted.description:
encrypted encrypts the disk. Built-in default false: ECS refuses encrypted
system disks in some zones (Singapore zone A, Hong Kong zone D), and true
takes those zones out of the offerings.

kmsKeyID.description:
kmsKeyID is the KMS key used for encryption; the account's default
service key when empty.

performanceLevel.description: performanceLevel of a cloud_essd disk. Built-in default PL0.

size.description: size of the disk, e.g. 64Gi. Built-in default 64Gi for the system disk.

aws.description:
Storage is the AWS storage block: the settings of the root volume, the extra
EBS volumes and the instance-local disks. It is the vendor block's storage
(layer 2) and the AWS block of a storage profile (layer 3).

data.description: data lists extra EBS volumes created with the instance.

items.description:
DataVolume is an extra EBS volume: EBS settings plus the guest side
(name, filesystem, mount path).

encrypted.description: encrypted encrypts the volume. Built-in default true.

filesystem.description: filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume.

iops.description: iops provisioned for gp3, io1 and io2 volumes.

kmsKeyID.description: kmsKeyID is the KMS key (ID, alias or ARN) used for encryption.

mountPath.description: mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at.

name.description:
name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints
rendered into Ignition.

throughput.description: throughput in MiB/s provisioned for gp3 volumes.

volumeType.description: volumeType is the EBS volume type.

localStorage.description:
localStorage configures the instance store disks of types that have
them.

mountPath.description: mountPath is the absolute path the local storage is mounted at.

policy.description:
policy: ignore leaves the disks alone, mount mounts them, raid0 stripes
them into one volume and mounts it.

root.description: root configures the root EBS volume.

encrypted.description: encrypted encrypts the volume. Built-in default true.

iops.description: iops provisioned for gp3, io1 and io2 volumes.

kmsKeyID.description:
kmsKeyID is the KMS key (ID, alias or ARN) used for encryption; the
account's default EBS key when empty.

throughput.description: throughput in MiB/s provisioned for gp3 volumes.

volumeSize.description: volumeSize of the root volume, e.g. 64Gi. Built-in default 64Gi.

volumeType.description: volumeType is the EBS volume type. Built-in default gp3.

azure.description:
Storage is the Azure storage block: the root disk, the extra managed disks and
the local disks. It is the vendor block's storage (layer 2) and the Azure
block of a storage profile (layer 3).

data.description:
data lists extra managed disks created with the VM, at the LUNs of their
order.

items.description:
DataDisk is an extra managed disk: Azure settings plus the guest side (name,
filesystem, mount path). Its device is /dev/disk/azure/scsi1/lun<N>, N the
index in the list.

caching.description: caching of the disk. Built-in default None.

filesystem.description: filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume.

mountPath.description: mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at.

name.description:
name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints
rendered into Ignition.

storageAccountType.description: storageAccountType is the disk SKU. Built-in default Premium_LRS.

localStorage.description:
localStorage configures the VM's temporary and local NVMe disks. Only
ignore is supported in v1.

policy.description: policy: ignore leaves the local disks alone.

caching.description: caching of the OS disk. Built-in default ReadWrite.

diskEncryptionSetID.description:
diskEncryptionSetID is the disk encryption set (customer-managed key) of
the disk; platform-managed keys (always on) when empty.

diskSizeGB.description: diskSizeGB of the OS disk. Built-in default 64.

ephemeral.description: ephemeral puts the OS disk on local storage instead of a managed disk.

placement.description:
placement of the ephemeral disk: the cache, the temporary (resource) disk
or the local NVMe disk. The size must support it and the image must fit.

storageAccountType.description:
storageAccountType is the disk SKU. Built-in default Premium_LRS (sizes
without the PremiumIO capability then get no offering: set
StandardSSD_LRS to include them).

fake.description: Storage is the fake storage block (vendor block and storage profile).

items.description: DataDisk is a fake extra disk.

filesystem.description: filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume.

mountPath.description: mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at.

name.description:
name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints
rendered into Ignition.

gcp.description:
Storage is the GCP storage block: the root disk, the extra disks and the
instance-local SSDs. It is the vendor block's storage (layer 2) and the GCP
block of a storage profile (layer 3).

data.description: data lists extra disks created with the instance.

items.description:
DataDisk is an extra disk: Compute Engine settings plus the guest side (name,
filesystem, mount path). The name is the disk's device name, so the guest
path /dev/disk/by-id/google-<name> is known before the launch.

filesystem.description: filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume.

kmsKeyName.description: kmsKeyName is the customer-managed encryption key.

mountPath.description: mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at.

name.description:
name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints
rendered into Ignition.

sizeGb.description: sizeGb of the disk in GiB.

localStorage.description: localStorage configures the local SSDs of types that include them.

mountPath.description: mountPath is the absolute path the local storage is mounted at.

policy.description:
policy: ignore leaves the disks alone, mount mounts them, raid0 stripes
them into one volume and mounts it.

diskType.description:
diskType of the boot disk. Built-in default pd-balanced, hyperdisk-balanced
for the series that boot only from Hyperdisk.

kmsKeyName.description:
kmsKeyName is the customer-managed encryption key
(projects/.../cryptoKeys/...); Google's own key when empty.

sizeGb.description: sizeGb of the boot disk in GiB (GCP's "GB"). Built-in default 64.

hcloud.description:
Storage is the Hetzner storage block: data volumes. It is the vendor block's
storage (layer 2) and the hcloud block of a storage profile (layer 3). There
is no root and no local storage: the root disk is the server type's, and
Hetzner servers have no local disks.

data.description:
data lists data volumes: each is created in the location before the
server and attached to it. Volumes outlive servers, so SCarpenter
deletes them once no server uses them.

items.description:
DataVolume is a data volume: its size plus the guest side (name, filesystem,
mount path). The first-boot unit formats and mounts it by its stable
/dev/disk/by-id link.

filesystem.description: filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume.

mountPath.description: mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at.

name.description:
name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints
rendered into Ignition.

size.description:
size of the volume, e.g. 100Gi. Hetzner counts GB: the size is rounded
up to whole GB and is 10 GB to 10 TB.

ovh.description:
Storage is the OVH storage block: the root disk and the extra Cinder volumes.
It is the vendor block's storage (layer 2) and the OVH block of a storage
profile (layer 3).

data.description: data lists extra Cinder volumes created with the instance (at most 8).

items.description:
DataVolume is an extra Cinder volume: its type and size plus the guest side
(name, filesystem, mount path).

filesystem.description: filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume.

mountPath.description: mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at.

name.description:
name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints
rendered into Ignition.

volumeType.description: volumeType is the Cinder volume type.

localStorage.description:
localStorage is not supported on OVH: a profile that asks for it is
unsupported for every type, and the vendor block is invalid with it.

mountPath.description: mountPath is the absolute path the local storage is mounted at.

policy.description:
policy: ignore leaves the disks alone, mount mounts them, raid0 stripes
them into one volume and mounts it.

root.description: root selects the root disk: absent, the flavor's local NVMe disk.

bootFromVolume.description:
bootFromVolume boots from a Cinder volume created from the image; the
flavor's disk is then unused. The only way to choose the root size and type.

volumeType.description: volumeType is the Cinder volume type.

qemu.description: Storage is the qemu storage block (vendor block and storage profile).

items.description: DataDisk is an extra disk image.

filesystem.description: filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume.

mountPath.description: mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at.

name.description:
name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints
rendered into Ignition.

localStorage.description:
localStorage configures the local disks of the instance types that have
them (the driver attaches them as extra disk images).

mountPath.description: mountPath is the absolute path the local storage is mounted at.

policy.description:
policy: ignore leaves the disks alone, mount mounts them, raid0 stripes
them into one volume and mounts it.

size.description: size the root image is grown to.

upcloud.description:
Storage is the UpCloud storage block: the root disk and the extra disks. It
is the vendor block's storage (layer 2) and the UpCloud block of a storage
profile (layer 3). UpCloud has no local disks: every plan disk is network
storage, so there is no localStorage here.

data.description: data lists extra disks created with the server and deleted with it.

items.description:
DataVolume is an extra disk: UpCloud settings plus the guest side (name,
filesystem, mount path).

encrypted.description: encrypted encrypts the disk at rest. Built-in default true.

filesystem.description: filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume.

mountPath.description: mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at.

name.description:
name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints
rendered into Ignition.

size.description: size of the disk, for example 100Gi; 10 to 1024.

root.description: root configures the root disk, a clone of the Flatcar template.

encrypted.description: encrypted encrypts the disk at rest (free). Built-in default true.

tier.description:
tier of the root disk. A clone keeps the tier of its template, so the
tier must be one an image template of the zone was made with. Built-in
default: the plan's included tier where a template of it exists, else the
tier of the template.

vultr.description:
Storage is the Vultr block of a storage profile. It is empty in v1: the plan's
disk is the root disk and extra block storage volumes are deferred, so a
storage profile with a vultr block makes every Vultr offering unavailable
with a reason.

storage.description: storage profiles: root and extra volumes, local storage.

additionalProperties.description:
Selection is a selection profile: sc-karpenter-nodepool's selector and
ranking, verbatim. At least one of them is set.

ranking.description: ranking keeps the best families of the candidates.

band.description:
band keeps the families whose objective is within a percentage of the
best family's.

withinPercent.description: withinPercent: keep families within this percentage of the best.

families.description: families bounds the number of kept families.

max.description: max keeps at most this many families, even if more are inside the band.

min.description:
min widens the band until at least this many families are kept (the
capacity floor).

normalize.description: normalize is applied to the score before the objective.

objective.description: objective is what the ranking optimises.

score.description: score is what to rank by.

benchmark.description: BenchmarkRef identifies one Spare Cores benchmark.

config.description:
config is a JSON object. Required when the benchmark has more than one
config; validated against Keeper's benchmark_configs by comparing
parsed objects.

id.description: id is a benchmark_id, for example geekbench:score.

workloadProfile.description: WorkloadProfileName is one of the Spare Cores compound workload benchmarks.

selector.description: selector filters instance types by Spare Cores data.

accelerator.description: AcceleratorSelector selects on GPUs and TPUs (Spare Cores "accelerators").

count.description:
count is inclusive and may be fractional (vGPU slices). max: 0 selects
servers without any accelerator.

manufacturers.description: manufacturers are Spare Cores values (NVIDIA, AMD, Habana, Google, ...).

memoryPerDevice.description: memoryPerDevice: memory of the smallest accelerator, lower bound.

memoryTotal.description: memoryTotal: memory summed over all accelerators, lower bound.

models.description:
models are exact Spare Cores model strings (L40S, A10G, ...); they are
not normalised across vendors.

types.description:
types restricts the type of the primary accelerator. Unknown types are
excluded when this is set.

items.description: AcceleratorType is the type of the primary accelerator of a server.

architectures.description:
architectures restricts the CPU architecture; intersected with a
kubernetes.io/arch requirement of the template.

items.description: Architecture is a Kubernetes CPU architecture name.

benchmarks.description: benchmarks are filters on benchmark scores; entries are AND-ed.

items.description: BenchmarkFilter is one filter on a benchmark score.

config.description:
config is a JSON object. Required when the benchmark has more than one
config; validated against Keeper's benchmark_configs by comparing
parsed objects.

id.description: id is a benchmark_id, for example geekbench:score.

max.description:
max is an inclusive upper bound, for lower-is-better benchmarks
(latencies).

min.description:
min is an inclusive lower bound on the (normalised) score, for
higher-is-better benchmarks.

allocations.description: allocations restricts the CPU allocation class.

items.description: CPUAllocation is how Spare Cores classifies the CPU time a type gets.

caches.description: caches filters on cache sizes (lower bounds only).

clockSpeedMinGHz.description: clockSpeedMinGHz is a lower bound on the vendor-reported clock speed.

flags.description: flags filters on Linux /proc/cpuinfo flag names, lowercase.

allOf.description: allOf: every listed flag must be present.

anyOf.description: anyOf: at least one listed flag must be present.

noneOf.description: noneOf: none of the listed flags may be present.

hyperthreading.description:
hyperthreading true selects types with more vCPUs than physical cores
(SMT siblings), false selects one vCPU per physical core. Unset: no
filter.

manufacturers.description:
manufacturers are exact, case-sensitive Spare Cores values (Intel, AMD,
AWS, Ampere, Alibaba, Microsoft, Hygon).

families.description: families include/exclude globs on the Spare Cores family string.

instanceTypes.description:
instanceTypes include/exclude globs on the instance type name
(server.api_reference).

memory.description: MemorySelector selects on memory size, in GiB.

perVcpu.description:
perVcpu bounds the GiB per vCPU (2 = compute-optimised, 4 = general
purpose, 8 = memory-optimised).

network.description:
NetworkSelector selects on network bandwidth. Setting a field excludes
every type without a value.
